provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Star Wars: Rebellion Learn to Play (Fantasy Flight Games)

steps.text: Decide who plays the Imperials and who the Rebels; each takes their miniatures, leaders, loyalty markers, faction sheet, mission cards and action cards
Each player puts the 4 leaders without a recruit icon in their leader pool; the others wait near the board
Join the two board halves; time marker on space 1, reputation marker on space 14
Objective deck: shuffle piles I, II and III separately and stack them III at the bottom, I on top; the Rebel player draws 1 in secret
Action decks: each player shuffles their action cards that have a recruit icon
steps.note: First game: the action cards without a recruit icon go back in the box

steps.text: Shuffle the space and ground tactic decks separately; markers and dice nearby
Missions: set your 4 starting missions aside; Imperial projects shuffled onto the Project space; shuffle the rest as your mission deck
Place starting units and loyalty as the first-game diagram shows
steps.note: First game: remove Corellia, Mandalore, Saleucami, Sullust and Mustafar from the probe deck. Later games: Advanced Setup, p.18

steps.text: Rebel player secretly picks a probe card for a system with no Imperial units and slides it under the Rebel base Location space; shuffle the probe deck
steps.note: First game: not adjacent to any Imperial units

steps.text: Starting hand: your 4 starting missions plus 2 cards from your mission deck
Both hands are secret; start the first game round
